newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Telebras rises on sale news.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Telebras rises on sale news.

text.p: American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) in Brazilian telecommunications holding Telebras were boosted on Wednesday by details of the company's privatization.
Telebras rose 1-1/4 to 98-7/8 after Brazil's Communications Minister, Sergio Motta, said total receipts from sale of the state telephone system should reach between $25 billion and $30 billion.

Motta said the funds should go to infrastructure investment and not to pay off public debt. Brazil's private news agency Invest News also reported Motta said Telebras' 1996 profit should exceed three billion reais.
Telebras has surged in recent weeks on prospects for privatization, rising from about 75 at the start of the year.

Among other Latin American ADRs, Peru's Compania de Minas Buenaventura rose 1-1/4 to 18 in heavy trade. The ADRs were boosted by a court ruling that increased its and Newmont Mining Corp's stakes in the biggest gold mine in Latin America.
Norway's Petroleum Geo-Services A/S rose 1-1/2 to 45-3/4 after the company announced it had won a $350 million contract from Conoco Inc, a unit of DuPont Co, to build and run a production ship.
British pharmaceutical company SmithKline Beecham Plc rose 1-3/8 to 76-3/8 on follow-through from Tuesday's announcement of a sharp rise in 1996 profits.
Swedish truck and bus maker Scania AK fell 1-7/8 to 24-1/4 after it reported a 44 percent drop in 1996 profits.
Advancers led decliners by 242 to 237 among 807 ADRs. Volume in late morning was 38 million shares.
